scope: DISCOVERY_ONLY; ten operations recommended for source-contract authoring, no source/runtime acceptance

common.authority: Meri request active guard and route roles are source prerequisites, not trusted authority obtained from the request/result DTO. New gateway must bind current tenant/actor/operation policy and deadlines independently. No connector is activated.
common.normalization: optionalString accepts only strings, trims then UTF-16 slices; clampInt legacy-coerces finite numbers then truncates/clamps. A strict typed contract must disclose intentional admission narrowing; never silently change aliases or existing result branches.
common.wire: Dates below are JSON wire strings/null corresponding to source Date fields; shape does not prove storage freshness or current-world truth. No candidate is a runtime acceptance.

input.roster: committee trim/cap200, jurisdiction lower/cap10 federal|state, chamber lower/cap10; state upper/cap2 required for state. Invalid/missing selectors return null committee/leadership and empty members.
input.members: state trim/cap40 resolved via exact shared state map, chamber lower/cap10 house|senate else absent, limit1..100/default100. Invalid state refuses even with chamber; no valid state/chamber returns empty note.

result.roster: Federal committee{id,name,chamber,jurisdiction,isSubcommittee,matchedBy}; members{id,name,party?,state?,side,rank?,title?}; nullable fields present. State committee{id,name,chamber?,jurisdiction,matchedBy}, NO state field; members{id,name,party?,chamber?,district?,role?}; rankingMember always null. Federal exact code is case-sensitive; state exact id is case-insensitive; normalized-name uniqueness otherwise resolver semantics. Chair/vice/ranking first source role matches; no cap.
result.members: tool/generatedAt, filter only normal branch, matchesFound==returned rows, members{id,name,party?,state?,district?,chamber}, note; isCurrent true. District numeric for House else null. No global total.
result.scalarOwner: Prisma CongressMember party/state nullable and district Int?; state chamber/district/party nullable; side string, rank Int?, title/role String?.

effectsAndAuthority.reads: withSystem stored committee/member reads only in selected methods; missing person rows dropped from federal membership. No provider/write observed in these paths.
effectsAndAuthority.sort: Federal rank uses null999; state roster retains returned source order. Name matcher result not independently provable from DTO.

qualificationLimits: Stored roster/current flags require adapter freshness qualification.
Current source/DTO/policy refs inspected here have no drift.
Parent allocated author during discovery; no mapping changed by this packet.

input.all: Required peCode string trimmed/capped32. Owner checks existence for contractors/bills and throws missing-element error; provision owner trims and can return empty.

result.bills: At most100 stored bills; fields id/congress/billType/billNumber/title/policyArea?/latestActionText?/latestActionDate?/url?/sponsor/committee?/peCodeCount; link nullable {type,confidence,evidence,status}; budgetPackage nullable {name,fiscalYear,track,stage}. Exact owner projection must be followed, including nullable storage types and fallback versioned links.
result.contractors: Missing award table returns {data:[],todo}; normal returns namedPrimes/data/evidence/evidenceNote/todo:null. Data rows contractorName/amount/awards/source plus attribution; SQL top10. Named primes top25 with contractorName/location?/contractMethod?/totalCostM?/fy?/sourceUrl?/pageNumber?/publisher?/attribution. Evidence keeps governmentExhibit and federalAwards separate.
result.money: 24-month award window; federalAwards amountM/count and accepted_direct/candidate/unmatched_dollars buckets. Government R-3 exhibit money remains compatibility-table provenance, not canonical money or award obligations. Unmatched zeros are response bucket values, not exhaustive attribution proof.
result.reportLanguage: ProvisionItem fields id/committee/fy/heading/text/pageStart?/pageEnd?/actionType?/sourceUrl?/matchBasis/reviewStatus/confidence/matchScope/attributionCaveat?. Exact matchScope pe_specific|program_level. Exposed reviewStatus accepted and candidate links retained; accepted program match branch. Dedup strongest match basis; sorted by source review/basis/FY, final cap50. Empty and program-level-only caveats from helper; no report absence proof.
result.wrapperEnvelopes: Report language: tool/generatedAt/peCode/provisions and optional note. Bills: tool/generatedAt/bills, NO peCode echo. Contractors: tool/generatedAt plus spread result, NO peCode echo.

effectsAndAuthority.reads: Stored Prisma reads, parameterized SQL versioned links/award compatibility data; no provider/model call in traced methods. ProgramElementReadService has other methods with different effects; no family-wide effect inference.
effectsAndAuthority.auth: Legacy owner accepts ctx but selected methods are global stored reads; tenant current authority still needs canonical gateway/context binding.

qualificationLimits: Author must trace schema scalar/nulls and exact inline response fields, not copy implementation.
Missing-table response is supported source envelope, not a missing DTO.
Award obligations versus exhibit values and accepted/candidate attribution stay distinct.
No canonical snapshot/funding accuracy qualification inherited from a shape.

input.search: query trim/cap240, source trim/cap60, limit1..50/default20; query matches title/summary case-insensitive or categories/topics exact array membership; optional source exact.

result.envelope: tool/generatedAt/total/data; rows id/source/title/url/author?/publishedAt/summary/categories/topics. title summarizes UTF-16 cap240; summary cap400, null->empty; whitespace normalized, truncated values end three dots.
result.counts: Independent concurrent list/count; total may be below returned length, no count completeness guarantee.
result.scalarOwner: id/source/title/url String; author/summary nullable String; publishedAt DateTime non-null; categories/topics String[].

effectsAndAuthority.reads: Two separate withSystem stored queries, publishedAt descending; no provider/write in wrapper.

qualificationLimits: Storage DateTime to wire policy must be declared; do not invent broader source bounds.

input.lookup: query trim/cap200 required for lookup, state upper/cap2 optional. Without state try federal documentNumber first; then state id matching state if supplied; otherwise title/abstract search.

result.refusals: found:false missing/no-match note; ambiguousMatches state+federal stored candidates, max6 each, not complete count.
result.found: tool/generatedAt/found/jurisdiction/id/title/abstract?/agencyNames/ruleType/stage/stageLabel/publicationDate/commentPeriod{start?,end?,isOpen}/effectiveDate?/docketIds/sourceUrl/linkedBillKeys; state adds filingDate?/linkedRuleNumbers/sourceRevision?/coverage; conditional note. Preserve exact federal/state scalar types.
result.truth: stage and isOpen derive source document type plus comment/effective dates and producer clock; no trusted asOf in input. Shape cannot attest current comment eligibility.

effectsAndAuthority.reads: Stored federal/state rules only in wrapper; no ingestion/provider writes.

qualificationLimits: Do not conflate ambiguity window with absence.
Current clock/release authority and full stored projection must be independently qualified.

input.lookup: Only program fedramp; nonempty trimmed query. Exact case-insensitive productId preferred, otherwise CSP/CSO name substring matches.

result.variants: All branches include tool/program/searchedEntireDataset:true. No-match found:false carries evidenceOfAbsence:true/note/sourceUrl/observedAt. Ambiguous found:true/ambiguous:true with full candidateCount and at most10 candidates. Single found:true/ambiguous:false with record. No query echo or generatedAt field is projected.
result.record: program/productId/cspName/csoName/status/impactLevel/authorizationDate?/sponsoringAgencies/sourceUrl/observedAt; types declared by FedrampProductRecord and source vocabularies.
result.absence: Retain source evidenceOfAbsence field as snapshot-scoped observation, never promote it to current/global negative authority.

effectsAndAuthority.effect: Live HTTP marketplace fetch and parse, 15s AbortSignal timeout per fetch, declared and actual response cap8MiB, body arrayBuffer before actual size check. One retry except identified nonserver HTTP errors; no shared total budget shown. No cache in traced helper.
effectsAndAuthority.auth: Governed egress/current-operation budget, full cancellation and provider/source provenance qualification required before connector execution.

qualificationLimits: Known HTTP/retry effect is not missing DTO.
No claim existing per-fetch timeout proves hard total duration or memory-bounded streaming.

input.lookup: optional clientId trim/cap64; missing returns facilities[]/note. Optional state upper/cap2 filters rows after lookup.

result.coverage: Unresolved or missing district representative is not absence of political representation. No invented upper bound.

effectsAndAuthority.reads: withTenant clientFacility lookup plus stored active/current federal/state legislators; no geocoding/provider/cache write in called representationForFacilities.
effectsAndAuthority.authority: Traced wrapper/owner shows tenant context but no explicit client visibility assertion; do not infer authorized client access from supplied id. New trusted authorization must explicitly establish client scope.

qualificationLimits: Contract-ready exact DTO; client-access adapter/policy remains unqualified.

input.lookup: No model selector consumed; owner function returns fixed registry summary.

result.envelope: tool/generatedAt/datasets; each key/description/supportsAsOf/fields; fields name/type/description/filterable/groupable/aggregatable. Types string|number|boolean|date|timestamp|string[]. No raw SQL/table/expression is projected.
result.scope: Describes registered query fields only; not row data, authorization to query them or proof of dataset coverage.
result.defaults: supportsAsOf defaults false; filterable/groupable default true; aggregatable iff type is number.

effectsAndAuthority.effect: Pure registry projection and generatedAt, no DB/provider call in invoked helper.

qualificationLimits: Separate from query_global_data, whose typed query/aggregation/tenant/global policy still needs its own review.
